title: OrderShipmentEvent
description: Event describing an error affecting one or more order items.

order_reference_id.description: A unique, case-sensitive ID of the order in Canva's system. This must be the same value as the `orderReferenceId` path parameter.

shipments.description: A list of shipments for the order.

request_type.description: The type of request. Must be `shipment_event`.

shipments.description: A list of shipments for the order.

ShipmentEvent.description: The shipment details for an item in the order.

tracking_number.description: The tracking number provided by the carrier.

carrier.description:
The Canva-supported carrier delivering the shipment. Valid carrier values include:
`allied_express`, `allwayex`, `amazon`, `ams`, `asendia`, `aus_post`, `b2c`, `blue_dart`, `bpost`, `bring`,
`bring_no`, `brt`, `canada_post`, `carriers`, `chitchats`, `chronopost`, `colissimo`, `correios`, `correos`,
`correos_express`, `couriers_please`, `deutsche_post`, `dhl`, `dpd`, `dpd_uk`, `estafeta`, `evri`, `fastway`,
`fedex`, `fleet_optics`, `france_express`, `gls`, `hunter_express`, `ics`, `icumulus`, `india_post`, `jadlog`,
`japan_post`, `landmark_global`, `laposte`, `loomis_express`, `lotte`, `nacex`, `new_zealand_post`,
`newzealand_couriers`, `norsk_global`, `ontime`, `pakman`, `paquetexpress`, `parcel_force`, `pitney_bowes`,
`planzer`, `post_nl`, `post_nord`, `purolator`, `quality`, `qxpress`, `royal_mail`, `sagawa`, `sda`, `seur`,
`shiprocket`, `spring_gds`, `star_track`, `swiss_post`, `tnt`, `toll`, `uniuni`, `ups`, `usps`, `yamato`.

dispatch_location_reference.description: The location reference ID of where the shipment was dispatched.

dispatched_at.description: When the shipment was dispatched, as a Unix timestamp (in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

carrier.description: The Canva-supported carrier delivering the shipment.

items.description: The items included in the shipment.

ShipmentItem.description: The items included in the shipment.

item_reference_id.description: A unique, case-sensitive ID for an order item that the partner can use when communicating with Canva.

quantity.description: The number of copies of an item that were shipped.
